text:
The Lava Beast Duel. The astronaut forgot the that the falling in lava doesn’t kill the lava monster. 

Seedance 2 prompt.  
Nightmarish volcanic alien world. Rivers of lava cutting through black mountains. Ash storms. Exploding gas vents. Red lightning inside thick smoke clouds. Survival horror action. Fast-paced camera work, violent handheld energy, rapid cuts, speed ramps. Sound: volcanic eruptions, creature roars, jetpack bursts, collapsing rock.

⸻

0–2s — HOOK

Wide shot.

An astronaut is already running along a narrow volcanic ridge.

Behind him—

A gigantic lava-covered alien beast charges.

Twelve feet tall.

Molten cracks glowing across its body.

Every footstep throws sparks and molten rock.

⸻

2–5s — ESCALATION

Side tracking shot.

The beast rapidly closes distance.

The astronaut fires a plasma rifle over his shoulder.

The shots hit.

Nothing happens.

The creature keeps coming.

A gas vent erupts beside them.

Fire blasts into the sky.

⸻

5–8s — BUILD

The ridge narrows.

Lava rivers on both sides.

The astronaut slips.

Recovers.

The beast launches itself forward.

Its claws barely miss his suit.

Ash and molten debris fill the frame.

⸻

8–11s — CHAOS

Overhead drone-style shot.

The entire ridge begins collapsing beneath their combined weight.

Massive chunks break away.

The astronaut jumps across a widening gap.

The beast follows.

The jump cracks the remaining rock.

Everything starts falling.

⸻

11–13s — PAYOFF BUILD

The ridge gives way completely.

Astronaut and beast plunge toward a raging lava river.

Bullet time.

The astronaut grabs a hanging volcanic rock formation.

The beast falls below him.

⸻

13–15s — FINAL PAYOFF

The creature crashes into the lava.

Molten rock erupts everywhere.

The astronaut looks down—

Relieved.

Then suddenly—

The beast erupts back out of the lava completely engulfed in fire.

Roaring.

Launching itself toward him.

translations.es:
---
Mundo alienígena volcánico de pesadilla. Ríos de lava atravesando montañas negras. Tormentas de ceniza. Ventanas de gas explotando. Relámpagos rojos dentro de densas nubes de humo. Acción de horror de supervivencia. Trabajo de cámara rápido, energía violenta de cámara en mano, cortes rápidos, aceleraciones de velocidad. Sonido: erupciones volcánicas, rugidos de criaturas, estallidos de jetpack, rocas colapsando.
---
translations.fr:
---
Monde extraterrestre volcanique cauchemardesque. Rivières de lave traversant des montagnes noires. Tempêtes de cendres. Évents de gaz explosifs. Éclairs rouges dans des nuages de fumée épais. Action de survie horrifique. Travail de caméra rapide, énergie violente de caméra à l'épaule, coupes rapides, accélérations. Son : éruptions volcaniques, rugissements de créatures, explosions de jetpack, effondrement de roches.
---
translations.ja:
---
悪夢のような火山の異星世界。黒い山々を切り裂く溶岩の川。灰の嵐。爆発するガスの噴出口。濃い煙雲の中の赤い稲妻。サバイバルホラーアクション。速いペースのカメラワーク、激しいハンドヘルドのエネルギー、急速なカット、スピードランプ。音: 火山の噴火、生物の咆哮、ジェットパックの爆発音、崩れ落ちる岩。

translations.ko:
---
악몽 같은 화산 외계 세계. 검은 산을 가로지르는 용암 강. 재 폭풍. 폭발하는 가스 분출구. 두꺼운 연기 구름 속의 붉은 번개. 서바이벌 호러 액션. 빠른 카메라 워크, 격렬한 핸드헬드 에너지, 빠른 컷, 속도 램프. 소리: 화산 폭발, 생명체의 포효, 제트팩 폭발, 무너지는 바위.
---
translations.pt-BR: Mundo alienígena vulcânico de pesadelo. Rios de lava cortando montanhas negras. Tempestades de cinzas. Ventos de gás explodindo. Relâmpagos vermelhos dentro de nuvens de fumaça espessa. Ação de horror de sobrevivência. Trabalho de câmera acelerado, energia violenta de câmera na mão, cortes rápidos, speed ramps. Som: erupções vulcânicas, rugidos de criaturas, explosões de jetpack, desmoronamento de rochas.
